title: Flagged media in log entries — Niko
hero.title: Why an image is missing from this log
hero.lead: Niko's server logs keep deleted messages for moderators. When Discord's automated content scanning has flagged an image, the log shows a placeholder instead of the image, and the entry links here.
type.explicit.name: Explicit content
type.explicit.what: Discord labelled the image as sexually explicit — the same check behind its sensitive-media warning.
type.gore.name: Gore
type.gore.what: Discord labelled the image as graphic violence: visible injury, blood, or similar shock content.
type.self-harm.name: Self-harm
type.self-harm.what: Discord labelled the image as self-harm content.
note.notStored: The placeholder is not a blurred copy. Niko never downloaded the image, so nothing from it is stored with the log entry.
note.kept: The message text, author, channel, timestamp and attachment names are still recorded.
